status.en: 14 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 36% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 14 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 36 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi forces continue air operations against ISIS hideouts in Kirkuk, using F-16 jets, while the government raised military readiness to the highest level and prioritized air defence amid regional tensions. The supreme court declared the Kurdistan Region security law unconstitutional and the Iraqi cabinet is being completed in a Thursday parliament session. Iraq detained 74 border infiltrators and advanced a security wall, and Prime Minister Barzani discussed security and investment with U.S. Consul General Wendy Green. The Iraqi National Security Advisor presented a strategic neutrality stance at MERI 2026. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske styrker fortsetter luftoperasjoner mot IS-huler i Kirkuk med F‑16‑fly, mens regjeringen hevet beredskapen til høyeste nivå og prioriterte luftforsvaret midt i regionale spenninger. Høyesterett erklærte sikkerhetsloven i Kurdistan-regionen grunnlovsstridig, og den irakiske regjeringen blir ferdigstilt i en torsdagssesjon i parlamentet. Irak har arrestert 74 grenseinntrengere og videreført en sikkerhetsmur, og statsminister Barzani diskuterte sikkerhet og investeringer med USAs konsulgeneralsekretær Wendy Green. Den irakiske nasjonale sikkerhetsrådgiveren presenterte en strategisk nøytralitetsholdning på MERI 2026. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
